name: Raiders of the North Sea Collector

categories.label: Victory Point track (incl. +50 if Ship card flipped)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track VP (+50 nếu đã lật thẻ thuyền)
categories.hint: Points scored during raids and offerings; add 50 if the Ship card shows the 50 VP side

categories.label: Valkyrie Track VP
categories.hint: Read the VP printed beside your marker; max 15 VP (7 Valkyrie)

categories.label: Armoury Track VP
categories.hint: Read the VP printed beside your Armour marker on the board

categories.label: Collected Offering Tiles VP
categories.hint: Sum the VP printed on your Offering Tiles

categories.label: Hired Crew end-game VP
categories.hint: Only crew cards that show an end-game VP value

categories.label: Livestock
categories.hint: 2 Livestock = 1 VP; a lone one scores nothing

tiebreakers.description: Player furthest up the Valkyrie Track
Then player furthest up the Armoury Track

endCondition.description: Ends when 1 Fortress raid remains, the Offering draw pile is empty, or no Valkyrie remain on the board; then each player (including the current one) takes one final turn.

notes: family: tracks-and-tiles. Track VP values (Valkyrie, Armoury), Offering Tile VP and Hired Crew VP are board/component-printed, so they are scorer inputs. Collector edition expansions/promos not verified; base-game end scoring assumed. Rulebook read via a third-party transcription, not the publisher PDF.
